lines.text: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne;
loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
Blessed are those who know the joyful sound,
who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
They rejoice in Your name all day long,
and in Your righteousness they exult.
For You are the glory of their strength,
and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
Surely our shield belongs to the LORD,
and our king to the Holy One of Israel.

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Hodler, Der Niesen — the one great mountain standing up out of the morning cloud with the snow bright along its ridge, Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name, mighty is Your arm, strong is Your hand
pictures.name: pd_hodler_bergen

pictures.scene: Giotto, Ognissanti Madonna — the throne built up high and the Child's hand raised in blessing over everyone standing round it, Your right hand is exalted, righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne
pictures.name: pd_giotto_troon

pictures.scene: David Teniers the Younger, Village Feast — the whole village out of doors together with the pipes going and the dancing started, loving devotion and faithfulness go before You, blessed are those who know the joyful sound
pictures.name: pd_teniers_jubel

pictures.scene: Carl Spitzweg, Der Sonntagsspaziergang — the family walking out together in their Sunday best along the sunlit path, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence, they rejoice in Your name all day long
pictures.name: pd_spitzweg_licht

pictures.scene: Rosa Bonheur, The Horse Fair — the great horses coming through in their strength with the men hanging on to the halters, and in Your righteousness they exult, for You are the glory of their strength
pictures.name: pd_bonheur_kracht

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Night Watch — the company stepping out into the light with the drum beating and the pikes and the shields going up, and by Your favor our horn is exalted, surely our shield belongs to the LORD
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_schild

pictures.scene: Anton Raphael Mengs, The Dream of Saint Joseph — the sleeping man with the angel bending close to speak to him in the night, and our king to the Holy One of Israel, You once spoke in a vision
pictures.name: pd_mengs_visioen
